# 1 Enoch Chapter 10 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of the Watchers

---

**1** Then the Most High, the Holy and Great One, spoke and sent Uriel to the son of Lamech, saying:

**2** 'Go to Noah and tell him in My name, "Hide yourself!" and reveal to him the end that is approaching — that the whole earth will be destroyed, and a flood is about to come upon the whole earth and will destroy all that is upon it.

**3** Now instruct him so that he may escape and his offspring may be preserved for all generations of the earth.'

**4** And again the Lord said to Raphael: 'Bind Azazel hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness. Make an opening in the desert that is in Dudael, and cast him in.

**5** Place upon him rough and jagged rocks, and cover him with darkness. Let him remain there forever, and cover his face so that he may not see light.

**6** And on the day of the great judgment he shall be cast into the fire.

**7** Heal the earth which the angels have corrupted, and proclaim the healing of the earth — that they may heal the affliction, so that not all the sons of men may perish through all the secret things that the Watchers have disclosed and taught their sons.

**8** The whole earth has been corrupted through the works taught by Azazel. To him ascribe all sin.'

**9** And to Gabriel the Lord said: 'Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, against the children of fornication. Destroy the children of the Watchers from among men. Send them against one another so that they may destroy each other in battle, for length of days they shall not have.

**10** No petition that their fathers make on their behalf shall be granted, for they hope to live an eternal life, and that each one of them will live five hundred years.'

**11** And the Lord said to Michael: 'Go, bind Shemihazah and his associates who have joined themselves with women so as to have defiled themselves in all their uncleanness.

**12** When their sons have slain one another, and they have witnessed the destruction of their beloved, bind them fast for seventy generations in the valleys of the earth, until the day of their judgment and consummation — until the judgment that is forever and ever is completed.

**13** In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire — to the torment and the prison where they shall be confined forever.

**14** And whoever is condemned and destroyed shall from that time be bound together with them until the end of all generations.

**15** Destroy all the spirits of the reprobate and the children of the Watchers, for they have wronged mankind.

**16** Destroy all wrong from the face of the earth, and let every evil work come to an end. Let the plant of righteousness and truth appear, and it shall prove a blessing. The works of righteousness and truth shall be planted in truth and joy forevermore.

**17** Then all the righteous shall escape, and shall live until they beget thousands of children, and all the days of their youth and their old age shall they complete in peace.

**18** Then the whole earth shall be tilled in righteousness, and all of it shall be planted with trees and filled with blessing.

**19** All desirable trees shall be planted upon it, and vines shall be planted on it. The vine planted upon it shall yield wine in abundance, and every seed that is sown upon it — each measure shall bear a thousand, and each measure of olives shall yield ten presses of oil.

**20** Cleanse the earth from all oppression, from all unrighteousness, from all sin and godlessness, and destroy from the earth all the uncleanness that is wrought upon it.

**21** And all the children of men shall become righteous, and all nations shall worship and praise Me, and all shall adore Me.

**22** And the earth shall be cleansed from all defilement, from all sin, from all punishment and torment. And I will never again send these upon it, from generation to generation, forever.'


---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Ge'ez text, preserving sentence structure and key theological vocabulary while producing readable English prose. Paragraph divisions follow the sense units of the Ge'ez.*
